title: Fokker--Planck Dynamics on Star Graphs with Variable Drift: Well-Posedness, Adjoint Analysis, and Numerical Approximation
summary: Stochastic transport processes on networked domains (modelled on metric graphs) arise in a variety of applications where diffusion and drift mechanisms interact with an underlying graph structure. The Fokker--Planck equation provides a natural framework for describing the evolution of probability densities associated with such dynamics. While Fokker--Planck equations on metric graphs have been studied from an analytical viewpoint, their optimal control remains largely unexplored, particularly in settings where the control acts through the drift term.
